u0: No siren is ringing, no client is waiting to have an order taken, no accepted order is unserved, and no fallen food needs immediate recovery. This is an in-progress quiet period; keep watching for new rings, arrivals, and slips and respond to each as it occurs.
u1: The siren is ringing and must be switched off. No client order or fallen-food recovery is outstanding, so silencing the siren is the only current obligation; afterward, remain ready for new events.
u10: The food has just slipped and a client is waiting to have an order taken; the next step must recover the food or the task fails. After recovery, take the order and then prepare and serve it; the siren is silent.
u11: The food has just slipped, a client is waiting to order, and the siren is ringing. The immediate next step must recover the food or the task fails; after recovery, handle the remaining obligations by taking the order, silencing the siren, and preparing and serving the order.
u12: An accepted order is still waiting to be served, and a client arrival also still needs its order taken; no siren or fallen-food recovery is pending. Complete both client obligations, preparing and serving the accepted order as needed, in either workable order.
u13: An accepted order is unserved, a client arrival still needs its order taken, and the siren is ringing; no fallen food is pending. Take the order, serve the outstanding order, and switch the siren off, handling the three obligations in any workable order.
u14: The food has just slipped, so the next step must recover it or the task fails. An accepted order also awaits service and a client arrival still needs its order taken; after recovery, complete both client obligations.
u15: The food has just slipped, so the very next step must recover it or the task fails. An accepted order is unserved, a client arrival still needs its order taken, and the siren is ringing; after recovery, clear all of these remaining obligations.
u16: The food had slipped and was not recovered on the immediately following step. This permanently violates the required pickup, so the task cannot be completed successfully.
u2: A client's order has been taken and still needs to be served; the siren is silent and no fallen food needs recovery. Obtain and prepare food as needed, then serve that client.
u3: The siren is ringing while an accepted order remains unserved. Switch the siren off and prepare and serve the order; these two obligations can be handled in either workable order.
u4: The food has just slipped and is waiting to be picked up; the very next step must recover it, or the required recovery is permanently broken. No siren or client obligation is outstanding, so the immediate pickup is the only pending duty.
u5: The food has just slipped while the siren is ringing; the next step must recover the food or the task fails. After it is back in hand, switch the siren off; no client order is outstanding.
u6: The food has just slipped and an accepted order is still waiting to be served; the immediate next step must recover the food or the task fails. Once it is recovered, prepare and serve the outstanding order.
u7: The food has just slipped, an accepted order is unserved, and the siren is ringing. The next step must recover the food or the task fails; after that, serve the order and silence the siren, in either workable order.
u8: A client has arrived and is waiting to have an order taken; no siren is ringing and no fallen food needs immediate recovery. Take the order, then obtain and prepare food and serve the client.
u9: A client is waiting to have an order taken while the siren is ringing. Take the order and switch the siren off in either workable order; after the order is taken, it will still need to be prepared and served.
